Satelliet hospitality furniture en De Br: Satelliet hospitality furniture and De Bresser, a strong team for years
Al ruim vier jaar werken Satelliet en De: For more than four years, Satelliet and De Bresser have been working together on a wide range of projects at home and abroad. From restaurants and hotels to cruise ships and holiday parks. For Sander Uphus, project manager at Satelliet, this collaboration has become a natural part of the success behind many projects.
Sander vierde onlangs zijn vijfjarig jub: Sander recently celebrated his fifth anniversary at Satelliet. He once started as an order planner, but now guides projects from start to finish as project manager. “I love visiting special places and working with different people. Whether it's clients, contractors or suppliers, I always try to build a positive relationship with everyone I work with.
De grootste voldoening haalt Sander uit: Sander gets the most satisfaction from the end result. “Sometimes you see an empty building turn into a beautiful space where people will come together. That never stops being special.” Projects such as a hotel in Schiedam, various restaurants, locations in Austria and even cruise ships are among the highlights of his career.
Daarbij speelt duurzaamheid een belangri: Sustainability plays an important role in this. “We're increasingly looking at reusing fittings and ways to extend the lifespan of products. That's how we shrink our ecological footprint.”
Voor veel projecten werkt Satelliet same: For many projects, Satelliet works together with De Bresser. What started as a contact through a former colleague grew into a close partnership. “We've really built something together. What makes the difference for me is the mentality of the people. Their willingness, flexibility and readiness to think along with us. You don't hear a ‘no’ very often.”
Volgens Sander is De Bresser veel meer d: According to Sander, De Bresser is much more than a supplier. “We see them as an extension of our own organisation. When they're on site, I know it'll be fine. Not just with the goods, but also with our customers.”
Ook het persoonlijke contact maakt het v: The personal contact also makes a difference. He mentions his regular point of contact, Aafke. “She unfailingly senses what's needed. Sometimes I only have to half explain the situation and she already understands what the right action is.”
Trots op wat samen is opgebouwd: Proud of what's been built together
Terugkijkend overheerst vooral trots. “S: Looking back, pride is the overriding feeling. “Together we've delivered some great projects, and we can definitely be proud of that!” He looks ahead with confidence. “When a challenging question comes up, I know that together with De Bresser we'll find a solution. That's ultimately what a strong partnership is all about!”
